$comment: Real-time (GTFS-RT) service settings; see PLAN.md §4.6. Upstream request rate is fixed by these intervals no matter how many clients connect.
$staleAfterS: Clients treat live data older than this as unavailable and fall back to schedule estimates.
$coverageGapS: Recorder coverage breaks when consecutive snapshots are further apart than this.
$maxInterpolateS: Interpolate a vehicle between two observations only when they are at most this far apart.
$maxExtrapolateS: At the live edge, dead-reckon a vehicle forward along its route for at most this long.
$prediction: Live bus prediction and learned travel-time profiles (src/core/rt/profile.ts, PLAN.md §4.5). Values are guesses tuned against recorded data with scripts/eval-rt.ts unless noted; see docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #25.

prediction.$bandStartHours: Time-of-day bands: night, AM peak, midday, PM peak, evening (local hours).
prediction.$stationaryM: GPS noise on a standing bus is ~5-10 m (measured: recorded fixes).
prediction.$stopExcessM: Slow time within this of a stop (vs the median pace of bins away from stops within baselineWindowM) is counted as dwell, since 30 s fixes smear dwells into nearby bins. Tuned with scripts/eval-rt.ts (2026-09-26): 75 m gives dwells of p25/p50/p75 22/32/45 s (plausible for RapidBus stops at signals) for ~2 m median / ~12 m p90 more error at 60 s than 0 m (no concentration, where buses visibly don't stop); 150 m costs 5/30 m.
prediction.$paceWeight: Tuned on 8 h training / 3 h test (2026-09-26): adapting to the bus's recent pace (any window 180-1200 s) made 30-90 s predictions slightly worse, so it's off; re-test with more history.
prediction.$catchUpMps: Glide: tuned with scripts/eval-rt.ts (2026-09-26): 8 m/s over ≤ 25 s keeps apparent speed p99 ≈ 24 m/s for ~1 m of median accuracy vs 12 m/s / 15 s.
prediction.$scheduleAnchorS: Schedule estimates for buses: TransLink gives every stop a time, interpolated between timepoints; pin to the timetable at most every this many seconds and let the profile place stops and slow sections in between. Guess.

$carry: Carrying RT bus delays into schedule estimates (src/core/rt/carry.ts). Guesses; see docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #25.
